trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this platinum unlocks automatically, so work the roadmap in stage order and let it pop with your final trophy.
steps: Follow the 7-stage roadmap in order, clearing missables first.
Finish every collectible, activity and crime trophy.
The platinum pops the moment your 54th other trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing, the first story mission of Chapter 1; it unlocks at the end of the mission and cannot be missed if you play the story.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the on-screen objectives through the mission.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every mission of Chapter 1; the trophy unlocks when the chapter's final mission ends, so keep pushing the story forward.
steps: Play each Chapter 1 mission in story order.
Clear the missable trophies flagged for Chapter 1 as you pass them.
Finish the chapter's last mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by finishing all of its story missions in order; watch for the Chapter 2 missables listed in the Missables view before the chapter closes.
steps: Play Chapter 2 missions in story order.
Grab the Chapter 2 missable trophies while the chapter is open.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full; the trophy pops at the end of its final mission, so clear the chapter's missables before you leave it behind.
steps: Play Chapter 3 missions in story order.
Clear the Chapter 3 missables flagged in this guide.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 by playing its missions in order; this is the last full chapter before the finale, so mop up its missables now.
steps: Play Chapter 4 missions in story order.
Clear the Chapter 4 missables before the finale locks them out.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission to earn this gold trophy; it is the story's last beat, so make sure every earlier chapter missable is already banked.
steps: Reach the finale by completing Chapters 1 to 4.
Double-check the Missables view before starting the final mission.
Complete the final mission to pop the gold.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run; it pops at mission end, and because it is a one-time story mission there is no way to earn it after the mission passes.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story.
Play the mission to completion.
The trophy unlocks at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist; like every named story mission it can only be played once, so it pops at the mission's end or not at all.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Play the heist mission to completion.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play; the trophy unlocks when the mission ends, so play it through rather than skipping ahead.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story.
Play the mission to completion.
The trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners; it is a one-time story mission, so the trophy pops at its end and cannot be earned later.
steps: Reach Headliners in the story.
Play the mission to completion.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport; the trophy pops at the mission's end, so finish it before moving on to the finale.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story.
Play the takedown mission to completion.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory; it pops at mission end, so do not rush past it on your way to the finale.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Play the mission to completion.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, the game's own checklist of story, strands, collectibles and activities; it is the last gold before the platinum, so treat it as the final cleanup sweep.
steps: Finish the story and all character and stranger strands.
Complete every collectible set and activity the checklist counts.
Check the in-game completion stat; at 100% the gold pops.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, airtime and drifts all count toward the total, so stunt constantly while you travel instead of saving it for the end.
steps: Stunt whenever you drive: jumps, near misses and airtime add up.
Use the counter in this guide to track your running total.
At 250 stunts the silver pops.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — shooting range, drone racing, racing, fishing, arcade, bowling, challenges, stunts and partner activities — and the trophy pops after the ninth type.
steps: Open the activities list and note the 9 types.
Play one of each type, even briefly.
The trophy pops once all 9 types are tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges; each range has its own par score, so replay any challenge you only silvered until every one shows gold.
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open its challenge list.
Play each of the 42 challenges and aim for gold.
Replay silvered challenges until all 42 are gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations; each location has its own course, so work through the list location by location until every one shows a win.
steps: Find a Top Fun Drone Race location.
Win the race at that location.
Repeat at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; the count is per race, not per win, so enter fresh races you have never won instead of replaying one favourite.
steps: Enter a race you have not won yet.
Win it to add one to the count.
Repeat until 20 different races are won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge; fish with Cal, outscore him on the challenge's catch tally, and the trophy pops when the challenge ends in your favour.
steps: Start a fishing challenge with Cal.
Out-fish him on the challenge tally.
Win the challenge to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish; pick the shortest cabinet you find, play it through to its end screen, and the trophy pops.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Start a game and play it to completion.
The trophy pops at the end screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission; character strands end with one last job, so keep taking Andy's missions until the finale appears and play it through.
steps: Take Andy's missions whenever they appear.
Keep going until his final mission unlocks.
Complete the final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission; work through his strand mission by mission until the finale unlocks, then finish it.
steps: Take Kenton's missions as they appear.
Continue until his final mission unlocks.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission; follow his strand to its last job and ride it out to the end.
steps: Take Billy's missions as they appear.
Continue until his final mission unlocks.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida; stranger icons appear on the map as you explore, so take every one you find until eight strands are finished.
steps: Explore Leonida and watch for stranger icons on the map.
Start each stranger strand you find.
Finish 8 full strands to pop the silver.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission; work his strand to its last job and finish it.
steps: Take Randy's missions as they appear.
Continue until his final mission unlocks.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission; follow his strand to its last job and finish it.
steps: Take Tyrone's missions as they appear.
Continue until his final mission unlocks.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida; each spot is a scenic point you sit at, so work the map spot by spot and tick them off as you go.
steps: Find a meditation spot and sit to meditate.
Note which spots you have done.
Meditate at all 18 spots.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret; Bret's hunting strand points you at one specific rare animal, so follow his lead, track it and take the shot.
steps: Take Bret's hunting strand when it appears.
Follow the trail to the unique animal.
Hunt it down to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets; cards are hidden around Leonida, so collect them set by set and check your collection progress after each find.
steps: Find collectible cards while exploring Leonida.
Complete one full set, then a second and a third.
The silver pops when your third set completes.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations; each spot counts once, so spread out across the map instead of repeating one place.
steps: Find a WAiNK It spot and use it.
Move to a new location and repeat.
Reach 100 different locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges from the game's challenge list; challenges span driving, shooting and exploration, so chip away at the easiest ones first and let the count build.
steps: Open the challenge list and pick easy ones first.
Complete challenges across driving, shooting and exploration.
Reach 50 completed challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape; stay together, break line of sight, and keep moving until the stars clear.
steps: Play with your partner and raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and keep moving to lose the cops.
Escape with your partner to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level; keep the heat on the whole run — escaping or dropping the stars breaks the chain.
steps: Start with your partner and rob a first shop.
Move straight to a second shop, then a third, without losing the wanted level.
The trophy pops after the third robbery.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles; every new model you drive or enter counts, so try every car, bike, boat and plane you see instead of sticking to one ride.
steps: Drive or enter vehicles you have never used.
Each new model adds one to the count.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus; pick a fight with a crowd, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it ends.
steps: Find a spot with at least 5 enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport — get a plane off the ground without a scheduled flight, and the trophy pops once you are airborne.
steps: Go to VCIA airport and get to a plane.
Take off without a scheduled flight.
The trophy pops on your unscheduled departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Survive the heat in a Rhino tank; the description points at the military Rhino, so get into one, draw the wanted level and stay alive in it.
steps: Find and enter a Rhino tank.
Draw police attention while inside it.
Survive the encounter to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected; go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
steps: Enter a jewelry store undetected.
Rob the store without triggering an alarm.
Leave unseen to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time; every vault counts once you get away clean, so plan the getaway before you crack each one.
steps: Find a bank vault and rob it.
Escape clean after the robbery.
Repeat for 5 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape; stop a truck on the road, take its cash, then lose the wanted level and get away.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Stop it and take the cash.
Escape to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida; the map fills in as you visit each area, so drive, fly and walk the whole state until every area is checked off.
steps: Travel through Leonida and watch areas fill in on the map.
Visit towns, coast, swamp and city districts.
All 52 areas visited pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs; every gang runs its own racket, so hit all nine and the trophy pops after the last one.
steps: Find an illegal operation run by a gang.
Rob it and escape.
Repeat for all 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach; head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a beachfront bar and order a cocktail.
Enjoy the view to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style; drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side.
steps: Get a car inside a vehicle showroom.
Build speed and aim for the glass.
Smash out through the front to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley; follow through on every frame until the game ends.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game of bowling.
Play it through to the end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build your partnership's mass appeal to its best — the exact trigger is not pinned down yet, so treat it as a partner-activity milestone and keep playing together.
steps: Play activities with your partner.
Build your partnership appeal over time.
The trophy pops when the partnership peaks.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make story choices — PSN tracks a count toward 500 — so pick a side whenever the game offers one, for better or worse, and keep choosing until the count is met.
steps: Take every choice the story offers you.
Choices in missions and dialogue add to the count.
Keep choosing until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on your second try — fail something once, then complete it on the immediate retry, and the trophy pops for the comeback.
steps: Fail a mission or challenge once.
Retry it right away.
Complete it on the second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida — a weird event out in the world — so keep your eyes open while exploring, especially in remote places at odd hours.
steps: Explore remote corners of Leonida.
Watch for strange events or encounters.
The trophy pops when you witness one.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle into a pedestrian and the trophy pops on the hit.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a pedestrian and swing as you pass.
The hit pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts; marked bills come from robberies, so keep cleaning them through contacts until the total hits $250,000.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida; clothes, weapons, food and cars all count, so buy freely and let the total climb.
steps: Shop at any store in Leonida.
Spend on clothes, weapons, food or cars.
Reach $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida; each garage is a property you buy, so visit every for-sale garage and buy them all.
steps: Find garage properties for sale.
Buy each one you find.
Own all 8 garages to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app; open the app, register each vehicle you own or find, and the trophy pops at the tenth.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register a vehicle to it.
Register 10 vehicles in total.
